ask.question: How many pallets (loads) are stored per location area?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    m.ARECOD AS [Location Area],
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.LODNUM) AS [Pallet Count]
FROM dbo.invlod AS l
INNER JOIN dbo.locmst AS m
    ON m.STOLOC = l.STOLOC
   AND m.WH_ID = l.WH_ID
WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND m.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY m.ARECOD
ORDER BY m.ARECOD;

ask.question: Which parts have no footprint detail?
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (200)
       p.prtnum,
       p.prt_client_id,
       p.dsp_prtnum,
       p.stkuom
FROM dbo.prtmst AS p
WHERE p.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
  AND NOT EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS d
          WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
            AND d.prtnum = p.prtnum
            AND d.prt_client_id = p.prt_client_id
      )
ORDER BY p.prtnum,
         p.prt_client_id;

ask.question: Count open pick work per wave / pick batch
ask.sql:
SELECT
    h.SCHBAT AS wave_pick_batch,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT h.WRKREF) AS open_pick_work_count,
    SUM(CAST(h.PCKQTY AS bigint) - CAST(h.APPQTY AS bigint)) AS open_pick_quantity,
    MIN(h.ADDDTE) AS oldest_open_work_added,
    MAX(h.ADDDTE) AS newest_open_work_added
FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr AS h
WHERE h.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND h.PCKQTY > h.APPQTY
GROUP BY h.SCHBAT
ORDER BY open_pick_work_count DESC, h.SCHBAT;

ask.question: List the 20 most recent inventory movements with part, quantity and from / to location
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (20)
       d.TRNDTE AS movement_date,
       d.PRTNUM AS part,
       d.TRNQTY AS quantity,
       d.FRSTOL AS from_location,
       d.TOSTOL AS to_location
FROM dbo.dlytrn AS d
WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND d.FRSTOL IS NOT NULL
  AND d.TOSTOL IS NOT NULL
  AND d.FRSTOL <> d.TOSTOL
ORDER BY d.TRNDTE DESC, d.DLYTRN_ID DESC;

ask.question: How many locations exist per area, and how many of them are empty?
ask.sql:
WITH occupied_locations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        i.wh_id,
        i.stoloc
    FROM dbo.invlod AS i
    WHERE i.wh_id = @wh_id
)
SELECT
    l.arecod AS area,
    COUNT(*) AS location_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.stoloc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS empty_location_count
FROM dbo.locmst AS l
LEFT JOIN occupied_locations AS o
    ON o.wh_id = l.wh_id
   AND o.stoloc = l.stoloc
WHERE l.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY l.arecod
ORDER BY l.arecod;

ask.question: Inventory quantity per part and inventory status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    d.PRTNUM AS part_number,
    d.INVSTS AS inventory_status,
    SUM(CAST(d.UNTQTY AS bigint)) AS inventory_quantity
FROM dbo.invlod AS l
JOIN dbo.invsub AS s
    ON s.LODNUM = l.LODNUM
JOIN dbo.invdtl AS d
    ON d.SUBNUM = s.SUBNUM
WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY
    d.PRTNUM,
    d.INVSTS
ORDER BY
    d.PRTNUM,
    d.INVSTS;

ask.question: How many pallets (loads) are stored per location area?
ask.sql:

    m.ARECOD AS location_area,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.LODNUM) AS pallet_count
FROM dbo.invlod AS l
JOIN dbo.locmst AS m
    ON m.STOLOC = l.STOLOC
   AND m.WH_ID = l.WH_ID
JOIN dbo.aremst AS a
    ON a.ARECOD = m.ARECOD
   AND a.WH_ID = m.WH_ID
WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND m.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND a.WH_ID = @wh_id

ask.question: Top 20 parts by number of pallets in stock
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (20)
    d.prtnum AS part_number,
    d.prt_client_id AS part_client_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.lodnum) AS pallet_count
FROM prodwms.invlod AS l
INNER JOIN prodwms.invsub AS s
    ON s.lodnum = l.lodnum
INNER JOIN prodwms.invdtl AS d
    ON d.subnum = s.subnum
WHERE l.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND d.untqty > 0
GROUP BY
    d.prtnum,
    d.prt_client_id
ORDER BY
    pallet_count DESC,
    part_number,
    part_client_id;

ask.question: How many unit loads are in each location zone?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.ulid) AS unit_load_count
FROM live3.locatn AS l
LEFT JOIN live3.unitld AS u
    ON u.subsit = l.subsit
   AND u.locatn = l.locatn
GROUP BY
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod
ORDER BY
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod;

ask.question: Top 20 items by number of unit loads in stock

       d.itmcod AS item_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.ulid) AS unit_load_count
FROM live3.unitld AS u

convert.title: CBO_P_CLASS_INVENTORY_DE07_VIEW
convert.sql:
-- PrIME 2022 / PRIME22_DE08
-- Bind @wh_id = 'DE08'.
WITH inventory AS (
    SELECT
        l.WH_ID,
        l.STOLOC,
        l.LODNUM,
        d.PRTNUM,
        d.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
        d.LOTNUM,
        d.INVSTS,
        d.FIFDTE,
        d.FTPCOD,
        d.SUP_LOTNUM,
        SUM(d.UNTQTY) AS UNTQTY
    FROM dbo.invlod AS l
    INNER JOIN dbo.invsub AS s
        ON s.LODNUM = l.LODNUM
    INNER JOIN dbo.invdtl AS d
        ON d.SUBNUM = s.SUBNUM
    WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
    GROUP BY
        l.WH_ID,
        l.STOLOC,
        l.LODNUM,
        d.PRTNUM,
        d.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
        d.LOTNUM,
        d.INVSTS,
        d.FIFDTE,
        d.FTPCOD,
        d.SUP_LOTNUM
)
SELECT DISTINCT TOP 200
       i.STOLOC AS LOCATN,
       i.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
       p.PRTFAM AS ITMGRP,
       i.LODNUM AS ULID20,
       CAST(
           FLOOR(
               CASE
                   WHEN ISNULL(r.UNTQTY, 0) = 0
                       THEN i.UNTQTY
                   ELSE CAST(i.UNTQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / r.UNTQTY
               END
           ) AS numeric(22,0)
       ) AS CASQTY,
       i.INVSTS AS QASTAT,
       i.FIFDTE AS FIFODT,
       i.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
       i.FTPCOD AS ULPALL,
       lo.ARECOD AS ZONCOD,
       SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()
           AT TIME ZONE 'Central Europe Standard Time' AS last_update,
       CASE LEFT(lo.ARECOD, 2)
           WHEN '01' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 1')
           WHEN '02' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 2')
           WHEN '03' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 3')
           WHEN '04' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 4')
           WHEN '05' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 5')
           ELSE CONVERT(varchar(12), 'not defined')
       END AS BLDING,
       CASE
           WHEN LEFT(p.PRTFAM, 1) = 'W'
                OR p.PRTFAM = 'PAPPWP'
               THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Wipes')
           WHEN LEFT(p.PRTFAM, 1) = 'R'
               THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Rawmaterial')
           WHEN LEFT(p.PRTFAM, 1) = 'P'
               THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Packmaterial')
           ELSE CONVERT(varchar(12), 'not defined')
       END AS MATTYP,
       CASE
           WHEN pal.HGT > 1 THEN CONVERT(int, pal.HGT)
           ELSE CAST(NULL AS int)
       END AS calculated_pal_height,
       r.UOMCOD AS UOM,
       NULLIF(LEFT(i.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
       NULLIF(SUBSTRING(i.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
       CONCAT(i.FTPCOD, i.PRTNUM) AS ULPAL_ITEM
FROM inventory AS i
INNER JOIN dbo.locmst AS lo
    ON lo.WH_ID = i.WH_ID
   AND lo.STOLOC = i.STOLOC
INNER JOIN dbo.aremst AS a
    ON a.WH_ID = lo.WH_ID
   AND a.ARECOD = lo.ARECOD
INNER JOIN dbo.prtmst AS p
    ON p.PRTNUM = i.PRTNUM
   AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = i.PRT_CLIENT_ID
   AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
           f.UOMCOD,
           f.UNTQTY
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS f
    WHERE f.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND f.PRTNUM = i.PRTNUM
      AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = i.PRT_CLIENT_ID
      AND f.FTPCOD = i.FTPCOD
      AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
    ORDER BY f.UOMLVL DESC, f.UOMCOD
) AS r
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
           f.HGT
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS f
    WHERE f.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND f.PRTNUM = i.PRTNUM
      AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = i.PRT_CLIENT_ID
      AND f.FTPCOD = i.FTPCOD
      AND f.PAL_FLG = 1
    ORDER BY f.UOMLVL DESC, f.UOMCOD
) AS pal
WHERE p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
  AND a.BLDG_ID = 'B1';

convert.title: Direct_LINE_BEVO_PRIORITIES
convert.sql:
WITH rl AS (
    SELECT l.LODNUM,
           l.STOLOC AS locatn,
           d.PRTNUM AS itmcod,
           d.LOTNUM AS ctlgrp,
           NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS vndcod,
           NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS vndlot
    FROM dbo.invlod AS l
    JOIN dbo.invsub AS s
      ON s.LODNUM = l.LODNUM
    JOIN dbo.invdtl AS d
      ON d.SUBNUM = s.SUBNUM
    JOIN dbo.prtmst AS p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = l.WH_ID
    WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND l.STOLOC NOT LIKE '%RWZ%'
      AND d.INVSTS = 'U'
),
B AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LODNUM) AS ULIDs,
           locatn,
           itmcod,
           vndlot,
           vndcod
    FROM rl
    GROUP BY locatn, itmcod, vndlot, vndcod
),
D AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LODNUM) AS ULIDs,
           vndcod,
           vndlot
    FROM rl
    GROUP BY vndcod, vndlot
),
A AS (
    SELECT h.PRDLIN AS PLNUMB,
           h.WKONUM AS PRDORD,
           h.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
           w.PRTNUM AS SPCCOD,
           w.WKOLIN AS LINSEQ,
           w.PRCLOC AS LOCATN,
           w.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
           NULLIF(LEFT(w.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
           NULLIF(SUBSTRING(w.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
           h.WKOSTS,
           h.SCH_BEGDTE,
           h.SCH_ENDDTE,
           w.LINQTY - w.TOT_DLVQTY AS open_qty
    FROM dbo.wkohdr AS h
    JOIN dbo.wkodtl AS w
      ON w.WKONUM = h.WKONUM
     AND w.WKOREV = h.WKOREV
     AND w.WH_ID = h.WH_ID
     AND w.CLIENT_ID = h.CLIENT_ID
    JOIN dbo.prtmst AS p
      ON p.PRTNUM = w.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = w.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = w.WH_ID
    WHERE h.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND w.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND h.WKOSTS IN ('P', 'I')
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND w.PRCLOC IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT A.PLNUMB,
       A.PRDORD,
       CASE WHEN A.WKOSTS = 'I' AND A.open_qty > 0 THEN A.SCH_BEGDTE END AS ACTDAT,
       CASE WHEN A.WKOSTS = 'I' AND A.open_qty > 0 THEN A.SCH_ENDDTE END AS ENDDAT,
       A.ITMCOD,
       A.SPCCOD,
       A.LINSEQ,
       A.LOCATN,
       A.CTLGRP,
       A.VNDCOD,
       A.VNDLOT,
       B.ULIDs AS ULIDs_anhand_Ort,
       D.ULIDs AS ULIDs_anhand_Vendor_Lot,
       FORMAT(CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Central Europe Standard Time' AS datetime), 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm') AS Last_Update
FROM A
LEFT JOIN B
  ON A.SPCCOD = B.itmcod
 AND A.LOCATN = B.locatn
 AND A.VNDLOT = B.vndlot
 AND A.VNDCOD = B.vndcod
LEFT JOIN D
  ON A.VNDCOD = D.vndcod
 AND A.VNDLOT = D.vndlot
UNION
SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
       FORMAT(MAX(t.TRNDTE), 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm')
FROM dbo.dlytrn AS t
WHERE t.WH_ID = @wh_id;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_DELIVERY_HISTORY_FROM_RTCIS
convert.sql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT
        d.TOSTOL AS LOCATN,
        d.TRNDTE AS SYSDAT,
        d.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(ds.LNGDSC, 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
        NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
        NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
        CAST(
            FLOOR(
                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.TRNQTY
                    ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
                END
            ) AS numeric(22,0)
        ) AS TRNQTY,
        ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS UOM,
        CASE
            WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
            ELSE w.WKONUM
        END AS PRDORD,
        LEFT(d.LODNUM, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = d.WH_ID
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
         AND pd.WH_ID = ph.WH_ID
        WHERE ph.LODNUM = d.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) w
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            f.UOMCOD,
            f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) u
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            x.LNGDSC
        FROM dbo.prtdsc x
        WHERE x.COLNAM = 'prtnum|prt_client_id|wh_id_tmpl'
          AND x.COLVAL IN (
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|' + d.WH_ID,
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|----'
          )
          AND x.LNGDSC IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN x.COLVAL LIKE '%|----' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
            CASE WHEN x.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
    ) ds
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.locmst lm
          JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
            ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
           AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
          WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
            AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
            AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
      )
      AND d.TRNDTE >= DATEADD(minute, -120, GETDATE())
      AND d.TRNDTE <= GETDATE()
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    LOCATN AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM m;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURN_HISTORY_FROM_DAS
convert.sql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT
        d.FRSTOL AS LOCATN,
        d.TRNDTE AS SYSDAT,
        d.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(ds.LNGDSC, 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
        NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
        NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
        CAST(FLOOR(
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.TRNQTY
                ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
            END
        ) AS numeric(22,0)) AS TRNQTY,
        ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS UOM,
        CASE
            WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
            ELSE w.WKONUM
        END AS PRDORD,
        d.LODNUM AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = d.WH_ID
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
         AND pd.WH_ID = ph.WH_ID
        WHERE ph.LODNUM = d.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) w
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            f.UOMCOD,
            f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) u
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            x.LNGDSC
        FROM dbo.prtdsc x
        WHERE x.COLNAM = 'prtnum|prt_client_id|wh_id_tmpl'
          AND x.COLVAL IN (
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|' + d.WH_ID,
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|----'
          )
          AND x.LNGDSC IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN x.COLVAL LIKE '%|----' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
            CASE WHEN x.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
    ) ds
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.locmst lm
          JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
            ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
           AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
          WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.FRSTOL
            AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
            AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.locmst lm
          JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
            ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
           AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
          WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
            AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
            AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
      )
      AND d.TRNDTE > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
)
SELECT TOP 200
    LOCATN AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS RETURN_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM m
ORDER BY SYSDAT DESC;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURN_HISTORY_FROM_RTCIS
convert.sql:
-- R11 IMP line return history (live RTCIS variant, last 33 days up to now) -> PrIME 2022.
-- Param: @wh_id. Window literal retained (OBS4); no DISTINCT, matching source grain (OBS8).
WITH m AS (
    SELECT d.FRSTOL AS LOCATN,
           d.TRNDTE AS SYSDAT,
           d.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
           LEFT(ds.LNGDSC, 15) AS ITMDSC,
           d.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
           NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
           NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
           CAST(FLOOR(
               CASE
                   WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.TRNQTY
                   ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
               END
           ) AS numeric(22,0)) AS TRNQTY,
           ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS UOM,
           CASE
               WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                   THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
               ELSE w.WKONUM
           END AS PRDORD,
           d.LODNUM AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = d.WH_ID
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
         AND pd.WH_ID = ph.WH_ID
        WHERE ph.PALLET_ID = d.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) w
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 f.UOMCOD,
                     f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) u
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 x.LNGDSC
        FROM dbo.prtdsc x
        WHERE x.COLNAM = 'prtnum|prt_client_id|wh_id_tmpl'
          AND x.COLVAL IN (
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|' + d.WH_ID,
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|----'
          )
          AND x.LNGDSC IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN x.COLVAL LIKE '%|----' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
                 CASE WHEN x.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
                 x.LOCALE_ID
    ) ds
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.locmst lm
          JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
            ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
           AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
          WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.FRSTOL
            AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
            AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.locmst lm
          JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
            ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
           AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
          WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
            AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
            AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
      )
      AND d.TRNDTE > DATEADD(day, -33, GETDATE())
      AND d.TRNDTE <= GETDATE()
)
SELECT LOCATN AS LINE,
       FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS RETURN_DATE,
       ITMCOD,
       ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
       CTLGRP,
       VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
       VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
       TRNQTY AS QTY,
       UOM AS WM_UNIT,
       PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
       ULID,
       CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM m;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURNS_90days_wholeQtyBack
convert.sql:
WITH moves AS (
    SELECT d.TRNDTE,
           d.PRTNUM,
           d.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
           d.LODNUM,
           d.FRSTOL,
           d.TOSTOL,
           CAST(FLOOR(CASE
               WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.TRNQTY
               ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
           END) AS numeric(22,0)) AS QTY,
           ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS UOMCOD,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM dbo.locmst lm
               JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
                 ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
                AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
               WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
                 AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
                 AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS to_line,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM dbo.locmst lm
               JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
                 ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
                AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
               WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.FRSTOL
                 AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
                 AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS from_line
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = d.WH_ID
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 f.UOMCOD, f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) u
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
),
RankedDeliveries AS (
    SELECT m.TRNDTE AS DELIVERY_DATE,
           m.TOSTOL AS LINE,
           CASE
               WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                   THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
               ELSE w.WKONUM
           END AS PROCESS_ORDER,
           m.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
           p.PRTFAM AS ITMGRP,
           g.LNGDSC AS grpdsc,
           m.QTY,
           m.UOMCOD AS WHSE_UNIT,
           m.LODNUM AS ULID,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY m.LODNUM
               ORDER BY m.TRNDTE ASC
           ) AS DeliveryRank
    FROM moves m
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = m.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = m.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
    LEFT JOIN dbo.dscmst g
      ON g.COLNAM = 'prtfam'
     AND g.COLVAL = p.PRTFAM
     AND g.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH'
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
         AND pd.WH_ID = ph.WH_ID
        WHERE ph.PALLET_ID = m.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = @wh_id
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) w
    WHERE m.to_line = 1
      AND m.TRNDTE > CAST(GETDATE() - 90 AS date)
      AND m.TRNDTE < CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
      AND m.TOSTOL NOT LIKE 'SLA%'
      AND m.TOSTOL NOT LIKE 'SLC%'
),
RankedReturns AS (
    SELECT m.LODNUM AS ULID,
           m.TRNDTE AS RETURN_DATE,
           m.QTY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY m.LODNUM
               ORDER BY m.TRNDTE ASC
           ) AS ReturnRank
    FROM moves m
    WHERE m.from_line = 1
      AND m.to_line = 0
)
SELECT TOP 200
       d.DELIVERY_DATE,
       d.LINE,
       d.PROCESS_ORDER,
       d.ITMCOD,
       d.ITMGRP,
       d.grpdsc,
       d.QTY,
       d.WHSE_UNIT,
       d.ULID,
       r.RETURN_DATE,
       r.QTY AS RETURN_QTY,
       DATEDIFF(MINUTE, d.DELIVERY_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE) AS DATE_DIFF
FROM RankedDeliveries d
JOIN RankedReturns r
  ON d.ULID = r.ULID
 AND d.DeliveryRank = r.ReturnRank
WHERE d.DELIVERY_DATE < r.RETURN_DATE
  AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, d.DELIVERY_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE) < 960
  AND d.QTY = r.QTY
ORDER BY d.ULID, d.DELIVERY_DATE ASC;
